CRPF promotes over 250 officers following Supreme Court order

The Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has promoted 267 officers, with over 250 of them receiving their first promotion in 15 years. This action follows an order from the Supreme Court. The promotions address a long-standing issue for these officers.
